seriesTitle: Star Wars: Visions Presents - The Ninth Jedi

episodes.title: Episode 1: A New Threat
episodes.summary: Pursued by Nawaam's army, Juro seeks aid from an old friend while Kara learns her father is alive.

episodes.title: Episode 2: A Hidden Weapon
episodes.summary: Desperate for allies, Kara and the Jedi rally a colony of asteroid miners to fight a common enemy.

episodes.title: Episode 3: Voice from the Past
episodes.summary: While rescuing civilians from Nawaam's attack, Kara uncovers the truth about her father's dark past.

episodes.title: Episode 4: Nawaam Attacks
episodes.summary: Kara finally faces off against Nawaam, who reveals why he kidnapped her father.

episodes.title: Episode 5: The Storm of Violence
episodes.summary: After a tragic loss, Kara questions her future as a Jedi, as Nawaam's grip on the galaxy tightens.

episodes.title: Episode 6: Light of the Force
episodes.summary: Taken prisoner by Nawaam's forces, Kara must team with an unlikely ally to escape.

episodes.title: Episode 7: The Jedi Strike Back
episodes.summary: Kara and the Jedi rally together in an effort to destroy Nawaam's ultimate weapon.

episodes.title: Episode 8: The Ninth Jedi
episodes.summary: Kara's belief in the ways of the Jedi are tested as she battles Nawaam for the fate of the galaxy.
